issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator. It gives no stopping time and no link to the murder.
issues.misreading: A solver could treat the stopped regulator as a clock clue that fixes or bounds the time of death, or assume it was stopped at a specific moment. The sheet gives no reading for it, so it should not be treated as evidence about the time.
